PolicyConfig.title: PolicyConfig
PolicyConfig.description: User protection model, content category filters, accountability lock settings, and system tamper defense flags.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the policy owner.

partnerName.description: Trusted accountability partner or administrator display name.

partnerEmail.description: Accountability partner or admin verification email.

unlockPin.description: 6-digit authorization PIN controlled by the trusted partner or admin.

cooldownMinutes.description: Mandatory time-delay cooldown in minutes before non-PIN policy relaxation.

blockAdultCore.description: Blocks known adult and pornography domains at DNS and hosts layers.

blockProxyVpn.description: Blocks known web proxies, DoH bypass resolvers, and unauthorized VPN endpoints.

enforceSafeSearch.description: Forces CNAME/VIP SafeSearch on Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, and YouTube.

blockMixedSocial.description: Restricts NSFW subreddits and adult-tagged media portals.

blockGambling.description: Blocks online casinos and betting platforms.

lockHostsFile.description: Enforces read-only ACL and watchdog hash verification on system hosts file.

lockDnsSettings.description: Locks network adapter DNS and OS MDM DNS-over-HTTPS policy.

uninstallProtection.description: Requires partner/admin authorization code before stopping service or uninstalling.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last policy modification.

BlockRule.title: BlockRule
BlockRule.description: Custom domain or URL pattern added to the user's blocklist.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the rule owner.

domain.description: Normalized domain or hostname to block.

strictLock.description: Whether removing this rule requires partner/admin authorization.

notes.description: Optional reason or note for blocking.

hitCount.description: Number of intercepted connection attempts to this domain.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when rule was created.

ScheduleWindow.title: ScheduleWindow
ScheduleWindow.description: Recurring time window during which strict blocking or total lockout is enforced.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the schedule owner.

enabled.description: Whether this schedule is currently active.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when schedule was created.

ProtectedDevice.title: ProtectedDevice
ProtectedDevice.description: Enrolled Windows, Android, or iOS device running a native SafeGuard enforcement component.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the device owner.

dnsLockActive.description: Whether OS-level DNS resolver lock is active.

hostsLockActive.description: Whether system hosts file or local VPN sinkhole is locked.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when device was registered.

AuditEvent.title: AuditEvent
AuditEvent.description: Immutable audit record of blocked domain requests, tamper alerts, and policy updates.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

target.description: Blocked domain, registry path, or policy target.

actionTaken.description: Enforcement action executed by the agent.

/policies/{userId}.description: Per-user tamper-resistant protection policy, category switches, and accountability partner configuration.

/schedules/{scheduleId}.description: Recurring blocking schedules and commitment lockout windows.

/devices/{deviceId}.description: Registered Windows, Android, and iOS endpoints running native protection services.

/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Immutable security ledger of blocked requests, tamper defenses, and authorization events.
